scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/ai run build && npm --prefix packages/core run build && npm --prefix packages/cli run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:pinned-deps && npm run check:license && npm run check:runtime-deps && npm run check:ts-imports && npm run check:doc-versions && tsgo --noEmit && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:major: npm version major --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
